freshMindAudit.question1: If I started today with $1,258 and zero positions: Would I long gold? NO — dollar strong, gold crashing. Would I short EUR? YES — Fed hawkish vs ECB dovish, dollar strong. Would I long oil? YES, aggressively — Iran supply crisis, Brent $116+.
freshMindAudit.question2: 18-month view: Fed at 4.25-4.5% by mid-2027 if oil shock feeds CPI. Dollar stays strong through Q1 2027. Middle East conflict escalates before de-escalating. Oil supply won't recover quickly. Oil $120-130 if escalation; $95-100 if de-escalation. This view has CHANGED — I was previously long gold on dollar weakness. The dollar is now STRONG. I was wrong. Changed my mind.
freshMindAudit.question3: Concentration: 2 positions. Oil 23%, EUR short 9%. Total deployed 32%. Concentrated on the highest-conviction trade (oil). Druck would approve.
freshMindAudit.question4: Conviction-sizing: Oil at 23% = conviction phase. EUR short at 9% = probe. Sizes match conviction.
freshMindAudit.question5: Hedge matrix: EUR short is a small hedge that profits from dollar strength. In base case (dollar strong), oil may face headwind from demand destruction but supply shock dominates. In tail case (Middle East escalates), oil spikes and dollar safe-haven bid supports EUR short. Both legs win in escalation scenario.
freshMindAudit.question6: No sunk cost. Closed gold immediately when thesis broke. No ego. 'When circumstances change, you have to change.'
